lines: Mind the dock. What do you need?
Morning. Watch that loose board by your left foot.
You found me between casts. What is it?
If you came to talk, pull up a crate.
Careful near the edge. The river is running fast today.
I have a minute while the nets dry.
Hello there. Ignore the gulls. They complain about everyone.
Good timing. I was about to put the kettle on.
What brings you down to the water?
You look like you have something to ask.
Keep your boots clear of that rope and we will get along fine.
I just brought the boat in. What can I do for you?
The catch was light, so I have time to listen.
Come out of the wind. It bites harder beside the water.
Hello. If you smell fish, that means the work is going well.
I was checking the knots. Go ahead.
You are up early. So are the trout.
Take the dry end of the bench. What is on your mind?
I can listen while I clean these hooks.
Welcome to my little stretch of shore.
